draft.text: You came in for your yearly check-up and to talk about your diabetes.
You are 24 years old and have type 2 diabetes.
You are taking metformin as prescribed, but your blood sugar levels have been up and down lately.
Your diabetes may not be well-controlled because of your new job at a bakery, which has made it harder to manage your snacks and blood sugar levels.
Your doctor will review your medication and help you find ways to better manage your diabetes at work.
You should keep track of your blood sugar levels and share any changes with your doctor.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you are having trouble managing your diabetes since starting a new job at a bakery.
You are taking metformin as prescribed and checking your blood sugars, but they have been up and down lately.
Your diabetes is not well-controlled, likely due to increased snacking on sweets at work.
Your doctor will review your medication and give you advice on managing diabetes in your work environment.
You should keep track of your blood sugar levels and report any changes.
A follow-up appointment will be scheduled to monitor your progress and adjust your treatment plan if needed.
